section: Notes > Settled: the pre-v1 build order and the staging rule
title: The staging rule is a monotone staircase: every stage, and every version inside a stage, ends with its own version number

section: Notes > Settled: the pre-v1 build order and the staging rule
title: A version is done when it works on real tasks, not when its checklist is closed

section: Notes > Settled: the pre-v1 build order and the staging rule
title: Every interface an earlier version shipped keeps working at every later version: no version removes a command or a surface that already works

section: Notes > Settled: the pre-v1 build order and the staging rule
title: Stages run in sequence, so a version is tagged before the next one opens

section: Notes > Settled: the pre-v1 build order and the staging rule
title: The CLI stage does not end when the basics work; it runs until the core product is usable from the CLI

section: Notes > Settled: the pre-v1 build order and the staging rule
title: The CLI stage's internal split is a version question, not a stage question

section: Notes > Settled: the pre-v1 build order and the staging rule
title: The first CLI version's scope stands: capture a task by title, list and inspect tasks, start and stop the timer, log and correct time, complete a task

section: Notes > Settled: the pre-v1 build order and the staging rule
title: The first CLI version uses a fixed sort of deadline then priority, with no ordering engine, no projects, no dependencies

section: Notes > Settled: the pre-v1 build order and the staging rule
title: Projects, dependencies, estimates, and scheduling arrive in later versions of the same CLI stage

section: Notes > Settled: the pre-v1 build order and the staging rule
title: The backend before MCP holds everything in specification section 2.1 that is not an interface: projects, dependencies, estimates, timetable and session, ordering, forecasts, warnings...

section: Notes > Settled: the pre-v1 build order and the staging rule
title: The Spring Boot API module arrives with the daemon stage and not earlier

section: Notes > Settled: the pre-v1 build order and the staging rule
title: The core stays framework-free, so the CLI versions carry no Spring dependency, and the build can enforce that rule

section: Notes > Settled: the pre-v1 build order and the staging rule
title: v1 is the release after the tray stage, so all stages sit inside the pre-v1 run

section: Notes > Settled: the pre-v1 build order and the staging rule
title: The release tagged v1 meets the completion signals in specification section 8.8

section: Notes > Settled: the pre-v1 build order and the staging rule
title: The first two stages of the earlier order collapse into one CLI stage made of several versions

section: Notes > Settled: the pre-v1 build order and the staging rule
title: The MCP stage opens only when the core product is complete and usable from the CLI

section: Notes > Settled: the pre-v1 build order and the staging rule
title: The CLI stage splits into versions by capability area: capture, list, timer and complete; then projects, dependencies, estimates, priority, deadlines; then timetable, session, ordered today...

section: Notes > Settled: the pre-v1 build order and the staging rule
title: The capability-area version split is recorded as an ordering constraint, not as the final release list

section: Notes > Settled: the pre-v1 build order and the staging rule
title: No version inside the CLI stage may remove a command an earlier version shipped

section: Notes > Settled: the pre-v1 build order and the staging rule
title: A stage may span several child efforts, so an effort is scoped to a capability group, not to "the CLI"

section: Notes > Settled: the pre-v1 build order and the staging rule
title: `release-plan` inherits the collapsed stage list, the capability axis, and the v1 tag position

section: Notes > Settled: the pre-v1 build order and the staging rule
title: `child-efforts` must expect several efforts inside the CLI stage

section: Notes > Settled: the pre-v1 build order and the staging rule
title: `architecture` must support the whole sequence with a framework-free core, an interactive CLI and an `mcp serve` subcommand in one binary, and additive versions

section: Notes > Settled: the pre-v1 build order and the staging rule
title: `decisions-service-mode` bites only at the daemon stage
